titleEnglish: The Character and Conduct of the Prophet ﷺ

verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَدِيدَ الْحَيَاءِ وَالتَّوَاضُعِ يَخْصِفُ نَعْلَهُ وَيَرْقَعُ ثَوْبَهُ وَيَحْلُبُ شَاتَهُ وَيَسِيرُ فِي خِدْمَةِ أَهْلِهِ بِسِيرَةٍ سَرِيَّةْ ۞ وَيُحِبُّ الْفُقَرَاءَ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَيَجْلِسُ مَعَهُمْ وَيَعُودُ مَرْضَاهُمْ وَيُشَيِّعُ جَنَائِزَهُمْ وَلَا يَحْقِرُ فَقِيرًا أَدْقَعَهُ الْفَقْرُ وَأَشْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-kāna ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama shadīda l-ḥayā'i wa-t-tawāḍuʿi yakhṣifu naʿlahu wa-yarqaʿu thawbahu wa-yaḥlubu shātahu wa-yasīru fī khidmati ahlihi bi-sīratin sariyyah, wa-yuḥibbu l-fuqarā'a wa-l-masākīna wa-yajlisu maʿahum wa-yaʿūdu marḍāhum wa-yushayyiʿu janā'izahum wa-lā yaḥqiru faqīran adqaʿahu l-faqru wa-ashwāh.
verses.en: He, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, was exceedingly modest and humble. He mended his own sandals, patched his garments, milked his ewe, and served his family in a noble manner. And he loved the poor and needy, sat with them, visited their sick, accompanied their funeral processions, and never looked down upon a poor person whom poverty had reduced to extreme hardship and destitution.

verses.ar: وَيَقْبَلُ الْمَعْذِرَةَ وَلَا يُقَابِلُ أَحَدًا بِمَا يَكْرَهُ وَيَمْشِي مَعَ الْأَرْمَلَةِ وَذَوِي الْعُبُودِيَّةْ ۞ وَلَا يَهَابُ الْمُلُوكَ وَيَغْضَبُ لِلّٰهِ وَيَرْضَى لِرِضَاهْ ۞ وَيَمْشِي خَلْفَ أَصْحَابِهِ وَيَقُولُ: خَلُّوا ظَهْرِي لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ الرُّوحَانِيَّةْ ۞ وَيَرْكَبُ الْبَعِيرَ وَالْفَرَسَ وَالْبَغْلَةَ وَحِمَارًا بَعْضُ الْمُلُوكِ إِلَيْهِ أَهْدَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-yaqbalu l-maʿdhirata wa-lā yuqābilu aḥadan bi-mā yakrahu wa-yamshī maʿa l-armalati wa-dhawi l-ʿubūdiyyah, wa-lā yahābu l-mulūka wa-yaghḍabu li-Llāhi wa-yarḍā li-riḍāh, wa-yamshī khalfa aṣḥābihi wa-yaqūlu khallū ẓahrī li-l-malā'ikati r-rūḥāniyyah, wa-yarkabu l-baʿīra wa-l-farasa wa-l-baghlata wa-ḥimāran baʿḍu l-mulūki ilayhi ahdāh.
verses.en: And he accepted excuses, never confronted anyone with what they disliked, and walked alongside widows and those in servitude. And he feared no kings, became angry for Allah’s sake, and was pleased with what pleased Him. And he walked behind his companions and would say, “Leave the space behind me for the spiritual angels.” And he rode camels, horses and mules, as well as a donkey that one of the kings had gifted to him.

verses.ar: وَيَعْصِبُ عَلٰى بَطْنِهِ الْحَجَرَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ وَقَدْ أُوتِيَ مَفَاتِيحَ الْخَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِيَّةْ ۞ وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الْجِبَالُ بِأَنْ تَكُونَ لَهُ ذَهَبًا فَأَبَاهْ ۞ وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُقِلُّ اللَّغْوَ وَيَبْدَأُ مَنْ لَقِيَهُ بِالسَّلَامِ وَيُطِيلُ الصَّلَاةَ وَيَقْصُرُ الْخُطَبَ الْجُمُعِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-yaʿṣibu ʿalā baṭnihi l-ḥajara mina l-jūʿi wa-qad ūtiya mafātīḥa l-khazā'ini l-arḍiyyah, wa-rāwadat-hu l-jibālu bi-an takūna lahu dhahaban fa-abāh, wa-kāna ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama yuqillu l-laghwa wa-yabda'u man laqiyahu bi-s-salāmi wa-yuṭīlu ṣ-ṣalāta wa-yaqṣuru l-khuṭaba l-jumuʿiyyah.
verses.en: And he would bind a stone against his stomach out of hunger, though he had been given the keys to the treasures of the earth. And the mountains offered to become gold for him, but he refused. And he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, refrained from idle speech, was the first to greet those he met with peace, prolonged the prayer, and kept the Friday sermons brief.

verses.ar: وَيَتَأَلَّفُ أَهْلَ الشَّرَفِ وَيُكْرِمُ أَهْلَ الْفَضْلِ وَيَمْزَحُ وَلَا يَقُولُ إِلَّا حَقًّا يُحِبُّهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى وَيَرْضَاهْ ۞ وَهَاهُنَا وَقَفَ بِنَا جَوَادُ الْمَقَالِ عَنِ الطِّرَادِ فِي الْحَلْبَةِ الْبَيَانِيَّةْ ۞ وَبَلَغَ ظَاعِنُ الْإِمْلَاءِ فِي فَدَافِدِ الْإِيضَاحِ مُنْتَهَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-yata'allafu ahla sh-sharafi wa-yukrimu ahla l-faḍli wa-yamzaḥu wa-lā yaqūlu illā ḥaqqan yuḥibbuhu Llāhu taʿālā wa-yarḍāh, wa-hāhunā waqafa bi-nā jawādu l-maqāli ʿani ṭ-ṭirādi fī l-ḥalbati l-bayāniyyah, wa-balagha ẓāʿinu l-imlā'i fī fadāfidi l-īḍāḥi muntahāh.
verses.en: And he would win the hearts of people of honour, show respect to people of virtue, and joke without ever speaking anything but the truth that Allah Most High loves and is pleased with. And here the steed of discourse comes to a halt, unable to race any further in the arena of eloquence, and the traveller of composition has reached the end of his journey through the vast expanses of exposition.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
